section_1_production_requirement.question: Primary use of the building on day one
section_1_production_requirement.example: bagged cement storage / food packaging / truck workshop

section_1_production_requirement.question: Heaviest single piece of equipment or vehicle operating inside
Crane, hoist or monorail — now or future
section_1_production_requirement.example: 5 tonne single girder overhead crane, phase 2

section_1_production_requirement.question: Site address, or the local design wind speed at that site
section_1_production_requirement.example: design wind speed calculated per the applicable code at the project location, expressed in km/h

section_1_production_requirement.question: Expansion plans in the next 5-10 years
section_1_production_requirement.example: +30% area to the north gable, year 5

section_2_conversion.buyer_says: I need a 30 m x 60 m warehouse

clear_span.note: 24 m to 30 m is not a 25% tonnage increase; expect 50-60% depending on loading

eave_height.note: finished floor to underside of eave purlin, not roof height

design_wind_speed.basis: calculated per the applicable code at the project location
design_wind_speed.note: no universal default applies; an exposed coastal site is almost always wind-governed, while a sheltered inland site may be governed by a far more modest wind case

crane_runway.note: obtain crane supplier load data before finalising any frame with crane provision

documented_case.error: 3 tonne electric hoist installed on a frame designed as a storage warehouse with no lifting provision
documented_case.consequence: hoist bracket cracked the column flange within 8 months of operation; on-site welded reinforcement with the building in partial use
documented_case.correct_design_added_cost: a modest premium relative to the original frame cost
